# AlignOrientation

- Inherits [`Constraint`](constraint.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("AlignOrientation")`

Turns `Attachment0` toward an orientation and holds it there. Use it to keep something upright, to make a turret face its target or to make a pet look where its owner looks. The target is the rotation of `CFrame`, or of `Attachment1` when `Mode` is `TwoAttachment`.

It does not spin a part continuously; for that, use an `AngularVelocity` or a hinge with a motor.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CFrame` | `CFrame` | `CFrame.identity` | read/write | For `OneAttachment`: the orientation in world space to turn toward. Only the rotation is used. |
| `Damping` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How strongly the constraint resists turning, in newton meter seconds per radian. Used together with `Stiffness`. Critical damping, which reaches the target without overshooting, is `2 * math.sqrt(Stiffness * I)` for a moment of inertia of `I`. Less overshoots and oscillates; more arrives slowly. |
| `MaxAngularVelocity` | `number` | `100000` | read/write | The highest speed at which the part is turned toward the target, in radians per second. Used only when `Stiffness` is 0. Near the target, the spring takes over. |
| `MaxTorque` | `number` | `10000` | read/write | The largest torque the constraint can apply, in newton meters, about each axis of the part. |
| `Mode` | `Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode` | `Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment` | read/write | Whether the target is `CFrame` (`OneAttachment`) or `Attachment1` (`TwoAttachment`). |
| `ReactionTorqueEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | For `TwoAttachment`: whether an equal and opposite torque is applied to the part that `Attachment1` is on. An arm aligned to a chest then also turns the chest. |
| `Responsiveness` | `number` | `10` | read/write | How quickly the constraint turns the part toward its target, as a frequency in radians per second. Used only when `Stiffness` is 0. The part arrives without overshooting. The value suits a single part; for a part with others jointed to it, such as the hips of a character, set `Stiffness` instead. |
| `RigidityEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the constraint turns the part to the target as fast as the simulation allows, ignoring the torque and speed limits. |
| `Stiffness` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The strength of the spring that turns the part to the target, in newton meters per radian. At 0, `Responsiveness` is used instead. Above 0, this and `Damping` set the response. For a load with a moment of inertia of `I` kilogram square meters, `w * w * I` gives a response of `w` radians per second. |
